operatorNotes: This snapshot provides technical privacy controls suitable for handling health information — encrypted message logs, role-based access, an audit trail and minimum necessary disclosure. It does not make your practice compliant with any health privacy regime. Compliance requires agreements, administrative and physical safeguards, staff training and audit, which are properties of your programme and not of this software. Take your own advice.

The templates deliberately contain no clinical detail, no treatment names and no reason for attendance. SMS and email are not confidential channels, and a reminder that names a procedure discloses it to anyone who sees the phone screen. Keep it that way when you edit them.

The enquiry form asks submitters not to include clinical details, because a public web form is the wrong place to collect them. If you need clinical intake, do it inside your practice management system.

Custom fields in this snapshot are administrative only. Do not add fields for diagnoses, medications or treatment history — the contact store is not a clinical record and does not have the controls one needs.
All sequences are created as drafts. Review the wording, and check your appointment reminder timing against your own no-show patterns, before activating.
